applicability.rationale: Customer relationship, contracts, and legal role require qualified review.
Precise location requires independent controls even if a workflow falls outside HIPAA.
Payer and customer contracts have not been reviewed.

controls.implementationRationale: Use purpose-aware field projections and deny excess fields.
Maintain asset, flow, threat, vulnerability, safeguard, and residual-risk records.
Require unique identity, tenant scope, least privilege, expiry, and break-glass audit.
Preserve actor, purpose, result, and material-change lineage without sensitive payloads.

controls.addressableAssessment: Implementation is required unless a documented risk assessment selects and justifies an equivalent measure; ADDRESSABLE never means optional.
controls.implementationRationale: Version, hash, and append-only lineage protect material evidence.
Authenticate people and system actors before regulated access.

controls.addressableAssessment: Transmission protection requires documented risk assessment and suitable safeguards; omission requires qualified rationale and equivalent control.
controls.implementationRationale: Protect approved payloads in transit and deny unapproved egress.
Preserve discovery and risk-assessment facts while qualified authority decides notification.
Verify the exact legal entity, service, configuration, region, subprocessors, and executed agreement.
Perform technical and non-technical evaluation on cadence and after material change.

assurance.legalDisclaimer: Contract machinery only; no legal role, HIPAA compliance, certification, vendor approval, or production-PHI authorization is asserted.

classifications.description: Non-public operational data without personal or health context.
Personal or workforce data not currently joined to health service.
Precise or historical person or device location and resulting inferences.
Identifiable NEMT rider-trip health context or data protected to the same conservative baseline.
High-impact financial, claim, payment, government identifier, or financial-integrity data.
Authentication, cryptographic, or recovery material prohibited from ordinary records and fixtures.

classifications.inheritanceRule: Effective classifications are the union of direct, inherited, joined, and escalation-rule classifications; no caller may subtract a classification.

officialSources.title: HHS FAQ: certification is not required or recognized
HHS FAQ: certification cannot replace a BAA

ARQ-002 operational default; qualified approval required
HHS documentation retention capability; applicability and start rule require review
